description: This file contains functions related to resizing and transform handle detection for elements in an Excalidraw-based drawing application, including hit testing, cursor management, and coordinate calculations.

methods.name: isInsideTransformHandle
methods.description: Checks if a point (x, y) is inside a given transform handle rectangle.

methods.name: resizeTest
methods.description: Determines if a given (x, y) coordinate is over a transform handle or resize area of an element, returning the handle type or false.

methods.name: getElementWithTransformHandleType
methods.description: Finds the first element under the cursor with a transform handle at the given scene coordinates.

methods.name: getTransformHandleTypeFromCoords
methods.description: Detects if a coordinate is over a transform handle or resize border based on element bounds.

methods.name: getCursorForResizingElement
methods.description: Returns the appropriate resize cursor style for a given element and handle type.

methods.name: getSelectionBorders
methods.description: Calculates the border lines of a selection rectangle, rotated by a given angle.

methods.name: rotateResizeCursor
methods.description: Adjusts resize cursor direction based on element rotation angle.
